title: Judging Against the Reference: Uncovering Knowledge-Driven Failures in LLM-Judges on QA Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM judges on QA tasks where the provided reference answers are artificially swapped (e.g., type-preserving, type-changing, popularity-based, and evaluator-knowledge swaps) to create conflicts with the models' internal parametric knowledge, and measuring the resulting accuracy degradation via the Reference-Polarity Accuracy Gap (RPAG).
